mapper.sql: SELECT a.*, cl.clinic_name AS clinic_name, p.name AS patient_name, p.medical_record_no, p.mobile, p.gender, p.age, d.name AS doctor_name, n.name AS nurse_name, c.name AS consultant_name FROM t_appointment a LEFT JOIN t_clinic cl ON a.clinic_id = cl.id AND cl.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN t_patient p ON a.patient_id = p.id AND p.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN t_employee d ON a.doctor_id = d.id AND d.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN t_employee n ON a.nurse_id = n.id AND n.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN t_employee c ON a.consultant_id = c.id AND c.is_delete = 0 WHERE a.is_delete = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS appointTotal, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status IN (3, 4, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visitTotal, SUM(CASE WHEN a.visit_type = 1 AND a.status IN (3, 4, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS firstVisit, SUM(CASE WHEN a.visit_type = 2 AND a.status IN (3, 4, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returnVisit, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bookedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS arrivedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS treatingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS leftCount FROM t_appointment a WHERE a.is_delete = 0 AND a.clinic_id = #{clinicId} AND a.start_time >= #{dayStart} AND a.start_time < #{dayEnd}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_appointment SET is_delete = 0, cancel_reason = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND is_delete = 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_appointment WHERE id = #{id} AND is_delete = 1
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, cl.clinic_name AS clinic_name, p.name AS patient_name, p.medical_record_no, p.mobile, p.gender, p.age, d.name AS doctor_name, n.name AS nurse_name, c.name AS consultant_name FROM t_appointment a LEFT JOIN t_clinic cl ON a.clinic_id = cl.id LEFT JOIN t_patient p ON a.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN t_employee d ON a.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN t_employee n ON a.nurse_id = n.id LEFT JOIN t_employee c ON a.consultant_id = c.id WHERE a.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_appointment WHERE is_delete = 1 AND id IN #{id}
